text:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx and missing forwarded audit entries for prod-internal (detected 2031-01-14T19:10:00Z). Paging @sre-oncall. Severity: P1.

incident-bot: Symptoms: spike in 500s on /v2/generate, audit-forwarder backlog growing, forwarder reports I/O errors reading /var/log/audit (EIO) starting 19:02:12Z. Several pods OOMKilled as buffers filled.

yana: i'm taking lead. initial signal looks like the forwarder couldn't read the audit dir; curious why EIO on a normal filesystem. checking node i/o and NFS mounts.

omar: i see heavy NFS retransmits to the logging NFS server starting 18:58. the NFS server was partially degraded during a scheduled patch window earlier today. some nodes still had mounts to the old NFS exporter. that explains EIO when kernel pages couldn't be read. tagging @infra-team.

sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) cordon affected nodes and move inference pods to healthy pool, 2) restart forwarder with empty buffer path on local disk so it can continue forwarding, 3) snapshot local audit dirs before any cleanup. who can run snapshots?

infra-team: starting immediate drain of pool-internal-3 and shifting traffic to pool-internal-fallback. initiating NFS remounts to corrected exporter on impacted hosts. will also kick off EBS snapshots of /var/lib/audit on nodes where the forwarder reports EIO.

security-team: observed gap in forwarded audit entries from ~19:02 to ~19:28 (~26 minutes). treat as potential evidence gap. do not rotate or delete keys; preserve all artifacts and record checksums. we need a forensics ticket and an SEC ticket for compliance exception.

forensics: creating FOR-9900 and starting collection. we'll snapshot /var/log/audit, journalctl, container logs, and forwarder buffer directories to s3://forensics/incident-1915550000/ (restricted). uploading manifest when complete.

yana: commands i'm running to preserve evidence:
```
# copy local audit dir and journal
sudo tar -czf /tmp/incident-1915550000/node-audit-$(hostname).tgz /var/log/audit /var/log/journal || true
# dump forwarder buffer if present
sudo tar -czf /tmp/incident-1915550000/forwarder-buffer-$(hostname).tgz /var/lib/audit-forwarder/buffer || true
# capture dmesg and iostat for kernel I/O errors
sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 > /tmp/incident-1915550000/dmesg.txt || true
iostat -x 1 10 > /tmp/incident-1915550000/iostat.txt || true
```

omar: NFS server team confirms a kernel panic during patch at 18:55 which caused the exporter to stall; they mitigated and brought it back at 19:20. nodes remounted at ~19:24. forwarder resumed successful reads by 19:28:03Z but we still need to collect forensics.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress -> monitoring when buffers drain. keep paged folks in thread.

security-team: required items for SOC2/ISO exception: 1) exact outage window for forwarded entries (owner: security-team, due: 2031-01-16 17:00 PT), 2) list of affected hostnames and container IDs (owner: infra-team, due: 2031-01-15 12:00 PT), 3) checksums of preserved artifacts (owner: forensics, due: 2031-01-15 18:00 PT), 4) analysis of any unusual principal activity during gap (owner: security-team, due: 2031-01-16 17:00 PT).

yana: also collecting traces and request ids for 18:50-19:40 to see which customer requests hit 5xx and whether retries caused duplicates. saving trace bundle to /secure/files/incident-1915550000/traces.tgz (restricted).

omar: snapshot commands for infra (pasted):
```
# tag and snapshot attached volumes containing /var/log/audit
aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-0abcde12345 --description "incident-1915550000 node-audit snapshot" --tag-specifications 'ResourceType=snapshot,Tags=[{Key=Incident,Value=1915550000}]' || true
# remount corrected NFS exporter
sudo umount /var/log/audit || true
sudo mount -o hard,nfsvers=4.1 nfs-export-correct:/exports/audit /var/log/audit || true
```

cs-team: customer impact: CS has two reports of transient 500s and possible duplicate outputs for acct-omega. preparing a hold notification; will wait for security sign-off. owner: cs-team, due: 2031-01-15 EOD.

forensics: upload in progress. manifest will contain SHA256 checksums and list of nodes. FOR-9900 will be updated when upload completes.

sre-oncall: action items captured for postmortem: 1) add NFS exporter pre-checks and failover to a second exporter during patch windows (owner: infra-team, due: 2031-01-31), 2) add local forwarder disk buffering policy and make buffer path on local guaranteed ephemeral disk (owner: eng-runtime, due: 2031-02-10), 3) add an alert for "forwarder-read-eio" with runbook (owner: security-team, due: 2031-01-25), 4) update on-call handoff checklist to ensure custody of artifacts (owner: oncall-handoff-bot, due: 2031-01-20).

incident-bot: oncall handoff note: @yana will stay as incident lead until 22:00 PT; an automated handoff will post in #oncall-handoffs at 22:00.

oncall-handoff-bot: recorded handoff: lead=yana, secondary=omar, start=2031-01-14T19:10:00Z, end=2031-01-14T22:00:00Z.

yana: scheduling postmortem: propose 2031-01-18 10:00 PT, 45m. invite list: eng-runtime, eng-sre, infra, security, cs, oncall rotation. i'll create the doc and attach artifacts: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/incident-1915550000 (internal draft).

security-team: compliance draft owner: priya. we'll assemble exception language noting outage caused by external NFS exporter kernel panic during a scheduled maintenance window, preserved artifacts, and mitigation plan. due: 2031-01-16 17:00 PT. ticket SEC-21045 created.

forensics: upload complete at 20:15Z; manifest and checksums available at s3://forensics/incident-1915550000/manifest.txt (access restricted). FOR-9900 updated.

cs-team: CS holding customer messaging; will only send templated notice if security confirms risk.

sre-oncall: final note: do NOT change or rotate any logging service credentials until security signs off and forensics confirms integrity. handing incident to postmortem owners. thanks all for quick coordination. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2031-01-14T20:20:30Z (mitigated, monitoring).

yana: closing thread here; follow-ups tracked in FOR-9900, SEC-21045, INF-10101, and the postmortem doc. please add any additional artifacts to the secure bucket and the postmortem doc before the meeting.
